method: full-text archive (agent/terms-archive, 2026-11-25): every archived terms/help paragraph matching the discretion, sanction, rule-change, separate-agreement, asymmetry and consistency lexicons reviewed by hand; sanction clauses re-read in the full text

facts.text: Any detected VPN or VPS use leads to 'the immediate closure of all associated accounts and the forfeiture of any accumulated profits'; after a payment dispute, Live-account profits 'will be duly settled in favor of UProfit'.

Practices that 'at our sole discretion, represent non-viable strategies' may lead to 'disciplinary actions, such as significant fines, trading restrictions, or permanent bans' (no explicit payout forfeiture outside the VPN clause).
